hero.title: Made for your gathering, baked with care.
hero.body: From celebration cakes to generous trays of rolls, we’ll help make your table feel special with a small-batch bake made just for your occasion.

details.title: Tell us what you’re planning
details.body: Share a few details about your event, the treats you have in mind, and when you need them. We’ll follow up to talk through availability, flavors, and pickup.

highlights.title: Event baking
highlights.body: Fresh breads, rolls, and sweet treats for family meals, office gatherings, and celebrations.

highlights.title: Local pickup
highlights.body: Custom orders are prepared for local Memphis pickup with timing confirmed before your order is finalized.

form.title: Start a custom order inquiry
form.intro: We’ll be in touch to confirm availability and the details of your request.
form.success: Thank you — we received your custom order inquiry and will be in touch soon.
